criterion_bindings.exemption: Envelope closure is a per-call schema property. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeRejectsUnknownVariantsAndFields and TestEnvelopeRejectsUnknownFieldsAcrossEveryOutcome (internal/agentcontract/envelope_test.go).
Authority semantics are per-call properties. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeGoldenOutcomes (internal/agentcontract/envelope_test.go).

Output bounds are producer-enforced per call. Inline bounds are proved by TestEnvelopeHasHardSerializedLimit (internal/agentcontract/envelope_test.go), TestMutationResultProducerAcceptsCanonicalPayload (internal/agent/envelope_test.go), and TestBudgetFieldsRefuseOrBoundResultsStructurally (internal/agent/runtime_test.go). TestMutationProjectionFailedAttemptMutations, TestFullWorkListProjectionCursorIntegrity and TestFullWorkListProjectionMultibyteEnvelopeFit prove oversized projection transport.
Cursor binding is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestAuthenticatedCursorBindsOperationAndRejectsTampering (internal/agent/runtime_test.go).

Durable-outcome honesty is proved at both levels: TestOutcomeMismatchIsClosedAndCannotDowngrade (internal/agentcontract/envelope_test.go) and the AJ6-partial-publication scenario of the agent-jobs corpus under TestAgentJobsCorpus (internal/agent/agent_jobs_corpus_test.go).

summary: Defines typed results, recovery, pagination, bounded omissions, and lossless oversized-result transport within the unchanged 51,200-byte envelope cap. Closed projection references require authenticated reconstruction and identity, length, digest and schema validation before authority; mutation documents are retained atomically and full-list paging preserves complete items and continuation. Size refusals name executable operation-specific recovery.
title: Agent result envelope
